title: Resource requests and limits
summary: Requests help schedule a container. Limits bound some resource use. CPU m means one thousandth of a CPU unit.
introduction: Requests help schedule a container. Limits bound some resource use. CPU m means one thousandth of a CPU unit. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Requests help schedule a container. Limits bound some resource use. CPU m means one thousandth of a CPU unit.

blocks.code:
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: "100m"
    memory: "64Mi"
  limits:
    cpu: "200m"
    memory: "128Mi"
blocks.title: Resource requests and limits

blocks.text: The request is 0.1 CPU and 64 mebibytes of memory. A low memory limit can cause the container to be stopped when it exceeds it.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Compare each request with its limit.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A request is not a measurement of current usage.
For more detail later, use this [Kubernetes further reading](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tutorials/kubernetes-basics/).

seo.title: Kubernetes: Resource requests and limits
seo.description: Learn about resource requests and limits in Kubernetes. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
